causal_path: St. Vincent hospital holds 15 usable units at 9 AM Monday July 20.
Centre dispatches 150 units at 4 PM Tuesday July 21.
Shipment arrives at hospital at 7 PM Tuesday July 21, adding 150 units.
Centre dispatches 150 units at 4 PM Thursday July 23.
Shipment arrives at hospital at 7 PM Thursday July 23, adding 150 units.
At Friday noon July 24, hospital holds 15 + 150 + 150 = 315 usable units.
reasoning: The world correctly implements the evidence: initial hospital stock 15 units, two scheduled shipments of 150 units each arriving before the deadline. The collection drive and centre stock are sufficient to support the shipments, but the world does not need to model them because the shipments are fixed by evidence. All uncertainties listed are either resolved by evidence or irrelevant to the terminal. The terminal 315 is the truthful number of units held at the deadline.
